scope: Three formulation-specific omissions discovered through broader amylin and combination searches. Separate from the existing oral ASC36 proposal in PR #868.

candidates.name: ASC36 subcutaneous injection
candidates.stage: US Phase I initiation reported by sponsor
candidates.summary: Ascletis reported injectable ASC36 Phase I initiation on 10 August 2026. Monthly-to-quarterly dosing is a development objective, not an established regimen.
candidates.limitations: Separate from oral ASC36. Registry corroboration remains missing; reported animal findings are not human efficacy evidence.

candidates.name: ASC36_35FDC subcutaneous combination
candidates.stage: US Phase I initiation reported by sponsor
candidates.summary: The same announcement reports Phase I initiation for a monthly injectable co-formulation targeting amylin, GLP-1 and GIP receptors.
candidates.limitations: Combination evidence is distinct from either monotherapy. No completed human efficacy results established; registry corroboration remains missing.

candidates.name: ASC35 subcutaneous injection
candidates.summary: The sponsor-submitted registry records a recruiting Phase I study of investigational monthly ASC35 Injection B, with an actual 27 August 2026 start, estimated enrolment of 84 and estimated June 2027 completion.
candidates.limitations: No results posted. The trial includes ascending-dose cohorts and a tirzepatide comparator; planned outcomes are not evidence of efficacy or superiority.
